cannotDraw: This graphic cannot be drawn yet — what it says:

warn.chartType: Unknown chart type “{type}” — drawn as columns (bar, hbar, line, stacked, share, scatter).
warn.noData: No data: a header row (first column the labels, then one column per series) and at least one row of values.
warn.noSeries: The header row needs at least one series after the first column.
warn.tooManySeries: Only the first {count} series are drawn — more cannot be told apart by colour (split into two charts).
warn.tooManyRows: Only the first {count} rows are drawn.
warn.notNumber: Row {row}: “{text}” is not a number (left empty).
warn.scatterX: A scatter plot needs a number in the first column of every row.
warn.negativeParts: Stacked parts and shares cannot be negative — negative values are left out.
warn.tooManyFunctions: Only the first {count} functions are drawn.
warn.noFunction: Nothing to draw: write a function (y = x^2) or a point (point: 1, 2).
warn.tooManyNodes: Only the first {count} boxes are drawn.
warn.noNodes: Nothing to draw: write connections (A -> B) or one box per line.
warn.direction: Direction “{text}” not understood (down or right) — drawn downwards.
warn.tooManyItems: Only the first {count} dates are shown.
warn.noItems: Nothing to show: one date per line (1815: what happened).

insert.help: A graphic is a block between ``` lines: ```chart, ```plot, ```diagram, ```tree, ```timeline. The preview below shows it as learners will see it.
